info.name: HOA Management System API — Springdale Village
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for the Springdale Village Homeowners Association Management System (Biñan City, Laguna).

**Base URL:** `{{base_url}}/api/v1`

**Authentication:** Laravel Sanctum — Bearer token. Run **Login** first; the token is auto-saved to `{{token}}` by the post-response script.

**Default seeded credentials:**
- SuperAdmin: `admin@springdale-hoa.ph`
- Board President: `rodrigo.aquino@springdale-hoa.ph`
- Treasurer: `lourdes.santos@springdale-hoa.ph`
- Resident: `carlos.reyes@gmail.com`
- Password (all): `Springdale@2026`

**Roles & permissions:**
- `super_admin` → full access to all modules
- `board_member` → financials, violations, announcements, maintenance, amenities, documents, meetings, reports
- `resident` → read own invoices/violations, submit maintenance, book amenities, view public docs/announcements, vote, update own profile
- `vendor` → read-only on assigned maintenance requests

**Modules:**
1. 🔐 Authentication
2. 👤 User Management
3. 🏠 Property Management
4. 💰 Financials — Invoices
5. 🚨 Violations
6. 📢 Announcements
7. 🔧 Maintenance Requests
8. 🏊 Amenities
9. 📅 Amenity Bookings
10. 📄 Documents
11. 🗳️ Meetings & Voting
12. 📊 Reports & Summaries
13. 🙍 Resident Profile

**Uniform response envelope:**
```json
{ "success": true,  "message": "...", "data": { } }
{ "success": false, "message": "...", "errors": { } }
```

**Public identifiers:** All resources expose **UUID** as the public-facing `id`. Route parameters and request-body FK fields (`property_id`, `amenity_id`, etc.) all accept UUIDs.

**Stack:** Laravel 13 · SQLite · Sanctum 4 · PHP 8.3+

variable.description: UUID of B1-L01 (seeded). Replace after migrate:fresh --seed.
UUID of Carlos M. Reyes (resident, seeded). Replace after migrate:fresh --seed.
UUID of any announcement. Populate by running List Announcements and copying an id.
UUID of any maintenance request. Populate by running List Maintenance Requests and copying an id.
UUID of Swimming Pool or another amenity. Populate by running List Amenities.
UUID of any booking. Populate by running List Bookings.
UUID of any document. Populate by running List Documents.
UUID of any meeting. Populate by running List Meetings.
UUID of any vote. Populate by running Show Meeting (votes are nested in the response).

item.name: 🔐 Authentication
item.description: Sanctum token-based auth. **Login** auto-saves the token to `{{token}}` so all subsequent requests are pre-authorized.

request.description:
Authenticates a user and returns a Sanctum personal access token.

The post-response test script auto-saves `data.token` → `{{token}}`.

item.name: 👤 User Management
item.description:
CRUD operations for HOA user accounts.

**Authorization:** `super_admin` only for create / update / delete.

**Roles:** `super_admin`, `board_member`, `resident`, `vendor`

request.description: Soft-deletes a user. **SuperAdmin only.**

item.name: 🏠 Property Management
item.description:
Property (unit) CRUD and resident assignment.

**Seeded:** 20 units across 5 blocks (B1-L01 … B5-L04).

**Authorization:** Create/Update/Assign: `super_admin`. View: all.

item.name: 💰 Financials — Invoices
item.description:
HOA dues ledger management.

**Invoice lifecycle:** `pending` → `overdue` → `paid` | `cancelled`

**Authorization:** Generate/cancel/pay: `board_member`+. View: all authenticated.

body.raw:
{
  "amount": 816.00,
  "payment_method": "online",
  "transaction_reference": "GCH-20260526-98765",
  "notes": "GCash payment — March 2026 overdue dues + late fee.",
  "paid_at": "2026-05-26 10:30:00"
}

item.name: 🚨 Violations
item.description:
Violation logging, state-machine transitions, and geotagged evidence.

**State machine:** `draft → issued → appealed|paid|resolved`

**Authorization:** Create/update/evidence: `board_member`+. View: all.

item.name: 📢 Announcements
item.description:
HOA bulletin board — notices posted by the board to homeowners and residents.

**Audiences:** `all`, `residents`, `board_members`

**Authorization:**
- Create / Update / Delete: `board_member` or `super_admin`
- List / Show: all authenticated users (residents see published + non-board-only)

**8 records seeded** (6 published, 1 draft, 1 expired). After seeding, run List Announcements and copy a UUID into `{{announcement_id}}`.

request.description:
Returns announcements visible to the authenticated user.

- **Board/Admin:** sees all announcements (published + drafts)
- **Resident:** sees only published, non-expired announcements for audience `all` or `residents`

Results are ordered: pinned first, then by `published_at` descending.

**8 seeded:** Annual General Assembly notice (pinned), water interruption (pinned), dues reminder, renovation guidelines, waste schedule, street light completion, security protocol draft, expired pool hours.

response.name: 200 – Announcement List

request.description: Returns a single announcement by UUID.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Community Clean-Up Day – June 7, 2026",
  "body": "Dear Residents,\n\nThe HOA invites all households to participate in our quarterly Community Clean-Up Day on Saturday, June 7, 2026 from 7:00 AM – 10:00 AM.\n\nMeeting point: HOA basketball court. Gloves and trash bags will be provided. Breakfast snacks will be served after the activity.\n\nYour participation makes Springdale Village a cleaner and better place for everyone!",
  "audience": "residents",
  "is_pinned": false,
  "published_at": "2026-05-26T08:00:00",
  "expires_at": "2026-06-07T12:00:00"

request.description:
Creates an announcement. **Board member / SuperAdmin only.**

**Fields:**
- `audience`: `all` | `residents` | `board_members`
- `published_at`: null = draft; past/current date = immediately published
- `expires_at`: optional; announcement stops appearing after this timestamp
- `is_pinned`: boolean, pinned items appear at the top of the list

item.name: 🔧 Maintenance Requests
item.description:
Residents submit maintenance issues; the board tracks, assigns, and resolves them.

**Status machine:** `submitted → in_review → in_progress → resolved → closed`

**Categories:** `plumbing`, `electrical`, `hvac`, `structural`, `landscaping`, `common_area`, `other`

**Priorities:** `low`, `normal`, `high`, `urgent`

**Authorization:**
- Create: any authenticated user
- Update status / assign: `board_member` or `super_admin`
- List: board sees all; residents see only their own submissions

**9 records seeded.** Run List Maintenance Requests and copy a UUID into `{{maintenance_id}}`.

request.description:
Returns paginated maintenance requests ordered by `created_at` descending.

**Resident behavior:** automatically scoped to own submissions — cannot see other residents' requests.
**Board behavior:** sees all requests across all properties.

**Optional filters:** `?property_id={{property_id}}` and/or `?status=in_progress`

response.name: 200 – Maintenance Request List

{

body.raw:

Please send a plumber for assessment and repair at the earliest convenience.",
  "priority": "normal"

request.description:
Submits a new maintenance request. **Any authenticated user.**

`property_id` must be a **UUID**. The request is automatically created with status `submitted` and linked to the authenticated user as `submitted_by`.

**Required:** `property_id`, `category`, `title` (5–200 chars), `description` (20–5000 chars)
**Optional:** `priority` (default: `normal`)

response.name: 201 – Request Submitted

body.raw:
{
  "property_id": "{{property_id}}",
  "category": "plumbing",
  "title": "Leaking Kitchen Faucet",
  "description": "The kitchen faucet has been dripping constantly for three days...",
  "priority": "normal"
}

response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Maintenance request submitted successfully.",
  "data": {
    "id": "<uuid>",
    "property": { "unit_number": "B1-L01" },
    "submitter": { "name": "Carlos M. Reyes" },
    "assignee": null,
    "category": "plumbing",
    "category_label": "Plumbing",
    "title": "Leaking Kitchen Faucet",
    "priority": "normal",
    "priority_label": "Normal",
    "status": "submitted",
    "status_label": "Submitted",
    "resolution_notes": null,
    "resolved_at": null,
    "created_at": "2026-05-26T09:00:00+00:00"
  }
}

request.description:
Transitions the maintenance request through its state machine. **Board member / SuperAdmin only.**

**Valid transitions:**
- `submitted → in_review | closed`
- `in_review → in_progress | closed`
- `in_progress → resolved | closed`
- `resolved → closed`

**Optional fields:**
- `assigned_to` — UUID of a user (vendor or board member) to assign the work to
- `resolution_notes` — required when transitioning to `resolved`

`422` is returned on invalid transitions.

response.name: 200 – Status Updated to Resolved

item.name: 🏊 Amenities
item.description:
Shared facility registry — pool, gym, hall, basketball court, etc.

**Authorization:**
- Create / Update: `board_member` or `super_admin`
- List / Show: all authenticated users

**5 seeded:** Swimming Pool, Multipurpose Hall, Fitness Center, Basketball Court (all active), Function Room (inactive – under renovation). Run List Amenities and copy a UUID into `{{amenity_id}}`.

request.description: Returns all amenities. Board/admin see all including inactive; residents see active only.

response.name: 200 – Amenity List

request.description: Creates a new amenity record. **Board member / SuperAdmin only.**

item.name: 📅 Amenity Bookings
item.description:
Facility reservation system — residents book amenities; board confirms or cancels.

**Booking status:** `pending → confirmed | cancelled`

**Business rules:**
- Time-slot conflict detection prevents double booking on the same amenity
- Inactive amenities cannot be booked
- `start_at` must be a future datetime; `end_at` must be after `start_at`

**Authorization:**
- Create: any authenticated user
- Confirm: `board_member` or `super_admin`
- Cancel: booker (own booking) or board/admin

**10 seeded:** 5 confirmed, 3 pending, 2 cancelled. Run List Bookings and copy a UUID into `{{booking_id}}`.

request.description:
Returns paginated bookings ordered by `start_at` descending.

**Optional filters:**
- `?amenity_id={{amenity_id}}` — scope to a specific facility
- `?status=pending` — filter by booking status

body.raw:
{
  "amenity_id": "{{amenity_id}}",
  "property_id": "{{property_id}}",
  "title": "Lopez Family Pool Reservation",
  "start_at": "2026-06-21 07:00:00",
  "end_at": "2026-06-21 09:00:00",
  "notes": "Family of 5. Two children under 12 will be accompanied by adults at all times."
}

request.description:
Reserves a facility for a specific time slot. **Any authenticated user.**

`amenity_id` and `property_id` must be **UUIDs**. `start_at` must be in the future. Returns `409` if the slot conflicts with an existing active booking.

response.name: 201 – Booking Created (Pending)
response.body:

  "success": true,
  "message": "Booking created successfully.",

request.description: Confirms a pending booking. **Board member / SuperAdmin only.**
Cancels a booking. Booker can cancel their own; board can cancel any. `cancellation_reason` is required when status is `cancelled`.

item.name: 📄 Documents
item.description:
HOA document library — by-laws, meeting minutes, financial reports, forms, and notices.

**Categories:** `rules`, `minutes`, `financials`, `forms`, `notices`, `other`

**Visibility:**
- `is_public: true` + `published_at` set → visible to all residents
- `is_public: false` → board/admin only

**Authorization:**
- Upload / Update / Delete: `board_member` or `super_admin`
- List / Show: all authenticated users (residents filtered to public only)

**9 seeded:** 7 public, 2 private. Run List Documents and copy a UUID into `{{document_id}}`.

request.description:
Returns paginated documents ordered by `published_at` descending.

- **Board/Admin:** sees all including private/unpublished
- **Resident:** sees only public + published documents

**Optional filter:** `?category=financials`

response.name: 200 – Document List

request.description: Residents get `404` on private or unpublished documents.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Board Meeting Minutes – May 17, 2026",
  "description": "Official minutes of the Springdale Village HOA Board of Directors regular monthly meeting held on May 17, 2026.",
  "category": "minutes",
  "file_path": "documents/minutes/board-meeting-minutes-2026-05-17.pdf",
  "file_name": "Board-Meeting-Minutes-May-2026.pdf",
  "file_size": 491520,
  "mime_type": "application/pdf",
  "is_public": true,
  "published_at": "2026-05-26T09:00:00"
}

request.description:
Registers a document record. **Board member / SuperAdmin only.**

Note: the API stores metadata only. The actual file upload is handled separately (e.g., Laravel Storage or S3). `file_path` is the storage path returned by your file upload handler.

Set `published_at: null` to keep the document unpublished (draft).

response.name: 201 – Document Created
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Document uploaded successfully.",
  "data": {
    "id": "<uuid>",
    "title": "Board Meeting Minutes – May 17, 2026",
    "category": "minutes",
    "category_label": "Meeting Minutes",
    "file_name": "Board-Meeting-Minutes-May-2026.pdf",
    "file_size": 491520,
    "mime_type": "application/pdf",
    "is_public": true,
    "published_at": "2026-05-26T09:00:00+00:00"
  }
}

request.description: Partial update. Use to publish a draft, change category, or update description. **Board member / SuperAdmin only.**
Soft-deletes the document metadata. **Board member / SuperAdmin only.**

item.name: 🗳️ Meetings & Voting
item.description:
Board meeting scheduling, agenda management, and resident voting.

**Meeting status machine:** `scheduled → ongoing → completed | cancelled`

**Vote flow:**
1. Board creates a vote attached to a meeting
2. Residents cast a single response per vote
3. Board closes the vote; tally becomes available

**Anonymous votes** hide individual choices in the tally — only counts per option are shown.

**Authorization:**
- Create meeting / Create vote / Close vote: `board_member`+
- Update status / Add minutes: `board_member`+
- Cast vote / View tally: all authenticated users

**4 meetings seeded** (2 completed, 1 scheduled, 1 cancelled). **3 votes seeded** (2 closed, 1 open with 10 pre-cast responses). Run List Meetings and copy UUIDs into `{{meeting_id}}` and `{{vote_id}}`.

request.description:
Returns paginated meetings ordered by `scheduled_at` descending.

**Optional filter:** `?status=scheduled`

response.name: 200 – Meeting List

request.description: Returns the full meeting including agenda, minutes, and all associated votes. Copy a vote UUID from `data.votes[0].id` into `{{vote_id}}`.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Special Board Meeting – June 2026 Security Protocol",
  "description": "Special meeting to finalize and ratify the updated visitor and vehicle entry protocol before the July 1, 2026 implementation date.",
  "location": "HOA Function Room – Springdale Village Clubhouse",
  "scheduled_at": "2026-06-28 14:00:00",
  "agenda": [
    "Call to Order",
    "Presentation – Updated Security Protocol (Jose T. Bautista)",
    "Board Discussion and Amendments",
    "Ratification Vote",
    "Publication Schedule"
  ]
}

request.description:
Schedules a new meeting. **Board member / SuperAdmin only.**

`scheduled_at` must be a future datetime. `agenda` is an optional array of strings.

request.description:
Partial update. **Board member / SuperAdmin only.**

Use to:
- Transition status: `status: "ongoing"` or `"completed"` or `"cancelled"`
- Record minutes after a meeting: `minutes: "..."` 
- Update agenda before the meeting

Status transitions are validated: `scheduled → ongoing → completed|cancelled`.

Creates a new vote within the specified meeting. **Board member / SuperAdmin only.**

**Fields:**
- `question` — the ballot question (required)
- `options` — array of 2–10 choice strings (required)
- `closes_at` — optional deadline; vote auto-expires after this datetime
- `is_anonymous` — if `true`, voter identity is hidden in response tallies

Vote is created with status `open`. The `{{vote_id}}` variable is auto-saved by the post-response script.

response.name: 201 – Vote Created
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Vote created successfully.",
  "data": {
    "id": "<uuid>",
    "creator": { "name": "Rodrigo B. Aquino" },
    "question": "Should the HOA install CCTV cameras at Gate 1 and Gate 2?",
    "options": ["Yes – approve CCTV installation", "No – not a priority", "Yes, but defer to FY 2027"],
    "closes_at": "2026-06-13T23:59:00+00:00",
    "is_anonymous": true,
    "is_open": true,
    "status": "open",
    "status_label": "Open"
  }
}

request.description:
Submits a vote response. **Any authenticated user.**

- `selected_option` must exactly match one of the options defined on the vote
- Returns `409` if the authenticated user has already voted
- Returns `422` if the vote is closed or the option is invalid

**Tip:** To cast a vote on the seeded open poll, run Show Meeting (AGA 2026) first, copy the vote UUID into `{{vote_id}}`, then call this endpoint logged in as a resident who hasn't voted yet.

response.name: 409 – Already Voted

request.description:
Returns the vote count per option. **Any authenticated user.**

For anonymous votes, individual voter identities are not exposed — only the aggregate count per option is returned.

**The seeded open poll** (dues increase) has 10 pre-cast responses (7 Yes, 2 No, 1 Neutral). Check the tally by copying the vote UUID from the AGA 2026 meeting.

response.name: 200 – Vote Tally

request.description:
Closes an open vote — no further responses are accepted. **Board member / SuperAdmin only.**

Tally remains accessible after closing.

item.name: 📊 Reports & Summaries
item.description:
Aggregated analytics for board members and admins.

**Authorization:** `board_member` or `super_admin` only.

All endpoints are `GET` with optional query parameters. No database writes occur.

query.description: Format: YYYY-MM. Defaults to current month.

request.description:
Returns invoice totals and collection rate for a given billing month.

**Response fields:**
- `period` — billing month (YYYY-MM)
- `collected` — total paid
- `pending` — total unpaid (pending status)
- `overdue` — total overdue
- `total_billed` — collected + pending + overdue
- `collection_rate` — percentage collected vs total billed
- `invoice_counts` — count per status

query.description: Number of trailing months to include (default: 6)

request.description: Returns a month-by-month breakdown of violations by status over the specified trailing period.

Returns current occupancy statistics across all active properties.

**Response fields:**
- `total_units` — all active properties
- `occupied_units` — units with at least one current resident (no `move_out_at`)
- `vacant_units` — unoccupied units
- `occupancy_rate` — percentage occupied

**Seeded:** 17 occupied, 3 vacant (B3-L04, B4-L04, B5-L03).

Returns a snapshot of open maintenance requests grouped by status and priority.

**Response fields:**
- `total_open` — requests not in `resolved` or `closed`
- `by_status` — count per status
- `by_priority` — count per priority level

item.name: 🙍 Resident Profile
item.description:
Resident self-service — view and update own profile without board involvement.

**Authorization:** Any authenticated user (own profile only).

Password change requires `current_password` to be provided and verified before the new password is accepted.

request.description: Returns the authenticated user's own profile. Equivalent to `GET /auth/me` but scoped to the profile module.

Updates the authenticated user's own name, phone, and/or password. **All fields are optional.**

**To change password**, include all three password fields:
```json
{
  "current_password": "Springdale@2026",
  "password": "NewPassword@2027",
  "password_confirmation": "NewPassword@2027"
}
```

**Password rules:** minimum 8 characters, mixed case, at least one number.

Returns `422` if `current_password` is incorrect.
